cohort: The study included 85 pregnant patients who received TNFai (certolizumab pegol) during the COVID-19 pandemic in Mainland China and 130 pregnant patients who did not use TNFai for comparison.
finding: TNFai administration in pregnancy was not associated with increased susceptibility to and severity of COVID-19, but TNFai users experienced more prominent symptoms and a longer recovery time, while pregnancy outcomes in this high-risk group were deemed satisfactory.
